Name: FAUNA - Familiar Allies Utility Network API
Author: CodysOasis
Description:
[heading]WHAT FAUNA ADDS FOR PLAYERS[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]The Familiar Den[/b] — a new farm building (built via Robin's shop) where your familiars live[/*]
[*][b]The Ouija Board[/b] — a craftable item that serves as a shop to purchase familiars[/*]
[/list]On its own, FAUNA won't add any creatures. You'll need a compatible content pack.
[line]
[heading]WHAT IS A FAMILIAR?[/heading]
Familiars are living companions with daily needs and a long-term relationship stat:
[list]
[*][b]Food and Attention[/b] — decay each day; keep them up through feeding and interaction[/*]
[*][b]Mood[/b]  — Your familiar will be happy if its needs are upkept, and sad if it isn't! This can impact their ability data.[/*]
[*][b]Trust[/b] — a long-term bond that grows over time and unlocks new abilities, but will slowly decay if the familiar is neglected[/*]
[/list]Each familiar has a [b]Diet Type[/b] (Carnivore, Herbivore, or Omnivore), individual gift preferences, and a set of abilities that activate as your Trust grows — ranging from skill buffs, harvesting, combat, fishing, healing, and friendship boosts with livestock and villagers.

Each familiar has their own room in the [b]Familiar Den[/b], and can be given a unique .tmx that operates similarly to a Spouse Room.
There is no limit to the amount of familiars that live in the den - rooms will be added infinitely as needed!
[line]
[heading]REQUIREMENTS[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley (latest)[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]No other dependencies.
To use, download the file, unzip it, and drop it into stardewvalley\mods.
Remember that you'll need a suitable content pack to get any creatures!

UPDATE 1.1
FAUNA got a big rework here, a huge organizational overhaul to be a Content Patcher framework instead of the original C#, AND A MODID CHANGE FOR FAUNA. 
With the ModId change comes the loss of 1.0 familiar save info - this is entirely my own fault and I apologize. This is my first time ever touching C# and it has come with some casualties :( 
Going forward the ModId should never have to change again, but even if it does, Familiar save data should now be stored in a way that is migration compatible if needed. No other data is negatively impacted to my knowledge.
[line]
[heading]FOR MOD AUTHORS[/heading]
FAUNA content packs are standard [b]Content Patcher[/b] packs — no C# needed, just JSON and sprite assets.

Full documentation:[url=https://github.com/CodysOasis/FAUNA---Familiar-Allies-Utility-Network-API/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md] docs-author-guide[/url]
Example pack: [url=https://github.com/CodysOasis/FAUNA---Familiar-Allies-Utility-Network-API/tree/main/examplepack/%5BFAUNA%5DVaelsFamiliars]example-VaelsFamiliars-github[/url]

[line]
[heading]EXAMPLE PACKS[/heading]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45156]Vael's Familiars[/url][/b] [i](part of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45040]Tales of the Aether Glade[/url])[/i] — 11 familiars across multiple species, sold through Vael's shop in the Aether Glade[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]COMPATIBILITY[/heading]
[list]
[*]✅ Compatible with most SMAPI and Content Patcher mods[/*]
[*]✅ Familiars are a distinct entity class — no conflicts with pet, trinket, or NPC systems[/*]
[*]❓ Report any conflicts on the Bugs tab[/*]
[/list][line]
